name: Brick Lane Bookshop
title: Brick Lane Bookshop: Independent Bookshop on Brick Lane Since 1978
description: Independent bookshop at 166 Brick Lane, E1. Open daily 10am–6pm. East London books, new fiction and author readings since 1978.

sections.title: Brick Lane's bookshop since 1978.
sections.text: An independent bookshop in the middle of East London's most famous street: local history, new fiction, and nearly fifty years of readings.

sections.title: Come in for one book. Leave with three.

items.title: East London shelf
items.text: Histories, memoirs and fiction of the East End, Brick Lane and Spitalfields.

items.title: New fiction
items.text: The latest novels, chosen by booksellers who read them.

items.title: Non-fiction
items.text: Politics, art, food, London and more.

items.title: Recommendations
items.text: Ask us. It's our favourite question.

sections.title: Writers have read with us for nearly fifty years.
paragraphs: Readings and launches over the years have included Michael Rosen, Adrian Mitchell, Andrea Levy, Hanif Kureishi, Jeanette Winterson, Sarah Waters, Beryl Bainbridge, Lionel Shriver, Jennifer Worth and Iain Sinclair.

sections.title: From Watney Market to Brick Lane.
items: Launches in Watney Market as part of the Tower Hamlets Arts Project.
Moves to Whitechapel, near the London Hospital.
Independent, open daily at 166 Brick Lane.
